title: Deutsche Bank reports cutting some loan approvals from weeks to minutes
dek: The bank says its AI-enabled corporate lending process accelerates narrower cases while using a managed internal agent platform.
evidence: Executive statements in Reuters; no independently audited accuracy or default-rate comparison
takeaway: Measure throughput together with exception handling, underwriting quality and auditability rather than decision speed alone.

sections.title: Deployment

bullets.detail: Technology chief Marie-Jeanne Deverdun said smaller, less complex corporate cases now take minutes rather than weeks; some multinational decisions moved from months to weeks.
The bank described ADA, an internal platform to create, monitor and govern agents, manage model risk and switch among models.

paragraphs: Reported result: Technology chief Marie-Jeanne Deverdun said smaller, less complex corporate cases now take minutes rather than weeks; some multinational decisions moved from months to weeks.
Operating layer: The bank described ADA, an internal platform to create, monitor and govern agents, manage model risk and switch among models.

sections.title: What is not established

bullets.detail: The reported turnaround improvement is a bank claim, not a controlled study of matched loan cohorts or a disclosed credit-quality benchmark.
Compare cycle time by case complexity with overrides, human review, model drift and realized credit outcomes before extrapolating to high-risk underwriting.

paragraphs: Evidence: The reported turnaround improvement is a bank claim, not a controlled study of matched loan cohorts or a disclosed credit-quality benchmark.
Practical test: Compare cycle time by case complexity with overrides, human review, model drift and realized credit outcomes before extrapolating to high-risk underwriting.
